[b][b]✭ [/b]HOW TO INSTALL:
[/b]#1 make sure you have the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1401]tractor mod[/url]﻿ & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4564]overgrown fairy buildings[/url]﻿ installed
#2 download the file for this mod and unzip it
#3 open the folder and copy garage.png
#4 locate the tractor mod folder found in the mods folder and paste the file in there, and confirm to replace the file with the same name (alternatively, delete garage.png in mods/tractormod before pasting)
#5 you're done! open the game, and your tractor garage should be changed to the overgrown fairy version

[b][b]✭ [/b]HOW TO UNINSTALL:
[/b]in the folder i also added a folder named "original file", inside that there is the original garage.png. repeat the steps above but instead use the file inside the  "original file" folder instead.
#1 copy garage.png from the "original file" folder
#2 paste the file in mods/tractormod, and confirm to replace the file with the modded one in there already (alternatively, delete the modded garage.png in mods/tractormod before pasting)

if you need help installing/uninstalling let me know.[b][i]

[/i][/b]take care! ♡
